title: Reactive Cart Service
description: Implement a cart service using BehaviorSubject and display items with async pipe.
problemStatement:
Build a reactive shopping cart that multiple components can observe. **Requirements:** 1. Generate a service `CartService`. 2. Inside, use a `BehaviorSubject` to hold an array of item names (initial empty). 3. Expose `items$` as an Observable (by calling `.asObservable()`). 4. Provide methods `addItem(item: string)` and `removeItem(item: string)` that update the BehaviorSubject. 5. Create a component `CartView` that injects the service and subscribes to `items$` via `async` pipe in the template: ```html
  • {{ item }}
``` 6. Create a component `CartActions` with an input field and an Add button. Use two‑way binding to capture the item name, and on click call `cartService.addItem()`. Also add a Remove button that removes the first item (if any). 7. Place both components in `AppComponent`. Verify adding/removing items instantly updates the list.
hints: Don’t forget to import `FormsModule` for ngModel.
BehaviorSubject requires an initial value: `new BehaviorSubject<string[]>([])`.
The `async` pipe will manage subscription and change detection automatically.
expectedOutput: Type a name, click Add: item appears in list. Click Remove: first item disappears. Everything updates reactively.
